I have no schooling and not much cash, so I will depend on my own hands and my family. I will plant the rice seed I saved from last year, and I will try to get some manure from the neighbor's cattle if I can. Rice takes a lot of work, especially weeding and bird scaring, so me and my wife and the older children will be in the field many days; I will only pay two or three people for a few days to help with transplanting.
